en.t: This time I could no longer avoid it.

units.source_text: 但是我吓得说不出话来。

en.t: But I was so frightened that I could not speak.

units.source_text: 因为还没有发出声音，给巴就在我的嘴里沸滚开了。

en.t: Before I had even made a sound, my stutter was already boiling up inside my mouth.

units.source_text: 我终于做出了连自己都想像不到的表情来。

en.t: At last I made an expression that even I could never have imagined.

units.source_text: 我莫名地对着老师莞尔一笑。

en.t: For some inexplicable reason, I smiled gently at the teacher.
